newsitem.title: JAPAN: Greenspan just changing planes in Tokyo-US embassy.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan just changing planes in Tokyo-US embassy.

text.p: U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan is just stopping in Tokyo on Friday to change planes on his way home from Beijing, a U.S. embassy spokesman said.
"We understand he is just changing planes," the spokesman said.
Spokesmen for the Finance Ministry and the Bank of Japan said they had not heard of any plans for Greenspan to meet any Japanese officials in their respective institutions.

Currency traders in Tokyo said on Friday morning the market was jittery partly on a rumour that Greenspan would meet Japanese finance and central bank officials to discuss the timing of interest rate rises in Japan and the United States.
